title: IvyWolfCatalog
description: Machine-readable catalog map for ivy-wolf.com. Source of truth for every collection, work, image stem, and product type. Prices stay HELD until the PIC sets them — never render a price whose status is 'HELD'. Reusable by Fly Naked and How2FlyPrivate via site-catalog-map (vault family website-whisper). Built 2026-09-28.

schema_version.description: Semver. Bump minor for new optional fields, major for breaking shape changes.

site.description: Site code matching image-intake-whisper/sites.json (IWA, FNK, H2P, …)

generated.description: ISO-8601 date this file was written or last rebuilt.

slug.description: URL slug matching the collections/<slug>/index.html route.

status.description: live = published; forthcoming = announced, not yet open; closed = sold out / archived.

product_type.description: collection-limited-edition: a fixed number of originals released once, never reproduced. commission: bespoke works. The two are NEVER mixed on a collection page.

credit.description: Always 'The Wolf Life'. No photographer name, no PIC name.

hero_stem.description: Stem (no width suffix, no .jpg) of the hero place photograph. The site appends -{width}w.jpg to build srcset URLs.

place_image_stems.description: All place photograph stems assigned to this collection. Order: hero first.

works.description: Artwork records (paintings) belonging to this collection. Empty until PHASE-5.0 cataloging.

title.description: Work title. 'TITLE HELD' while PIC hasn't named it.

size_in.description: Dimensions in inches, e.g. '20 × 28 in'. 'HELD' until measured.

size_cm.description: Dimensions in centimetres, e.g. '50 × 70 cm'. 'HELD' until measured.

image_stems.description: Artwork photograph stems. Empty until PHASE-5.0 photography.

edition_size.description: Total number of originals in this edition. null = not yet set by PIC.

price.description: Dollar amount OR 'HELD'. Never invent a price. Reader must suppress display when value is 'HELD'.

product_type.description: Inherits from collection. collection-limited-edition only — commissions are never items in a collection.
